title: Black, then a star
camera: EWS · 35 mm · locked off
action: Starfield. A point of light swells into a blue-white bloom as the bubble collapses (~5 s). The Endeavor resolves out of it, shield forward, both warp rings glowing, fins stowed as they must be in warp.
sound: Silence. A sub-bass drop as the bubble collapses.

title: Rings cool
camera: CU · 50 mm · slow push along the bow ring
action: The front warp ring's emitters fade from blue to dark. A burst of bow RCS trims the drift.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Actual, Endeavor. Clean exit. Rings cooling.
sound: Ticking metal and RCS thumps through the hull (camera rides the ring).

title: The task group
camera: EWS · 85 mm · long lens, locked off
action: Staggered warp flashes, seconds and 50+ km apart: the Astrid, the hedgehog pack, the Donnager, the Excelsior, both destroyers, four corvettes, the Nauvoo. Far beyond, Maren is a blue crescent, Skerry a grey dot, and the Breakers a faint glittering band.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Thirteen for thirteen. Everyone's home.
vfx: 12 warp flashes, the Breakers' glitter band
assets: AST GI GI-MAV DD CV TND MAREN SKR BRK FX-WARP SUB
sound: Distant low thuds, one per exit (score, not diegetic).

title: Shields to the park
camera: MS · 35 mm · behind the shield, looking aft at the bow
action: Separation thrusters fire between the front ring's spokes; the gold impact shield backs away and drifts toward a cluster of parked shields where the Nauvoo waits, the Excelsior on guard. Both warp rings stay on the ship. Every shield parked here at near-zero speed can be collected after the battle.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Nauvoo, Endeavor. The shield's yours. | NAUVOO: Got it. We'll leave the porch light off.
assets: EN SHD TND GI GI-PD SUB
sound: Clamp bangs through the ring truss, then quiet.

title: The moon speaks
camera: HUD insert · Astrid telescope feed, 2,000 mm equivalent
action: On the telescope feed, a thread of light runs along Skerry's dark limb: the mass driver's track arcing as it throws. Three tracks leave the moon. The plot tags them: impact region, the final approach lane; time of flight, about seven hours.
comms: ASTRID SENSORS: Launch on Skerry. Three rounds, heading down our lane. | TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Noted. They'll be hours.
sound: Soft sensor tones.

title: The Astrid looks
camera: MS · 50 mm · the AVPSA dish slewing, cut to HUD insert
action: The Astrid's 100 m AVPSA dish slews. On the plot, tracks bloom: Breakwater parked over Site 1, Skerry's battery and tracks, three Compact frigates, forty-plus unknowns in the Breakers. The destroyers' net comes up and the fleet goes radio-silent.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Picture's up. Breakwater's parked over their big laser, like the brief said.
sound: Soft sensor pings.

title: Wave one
camera: WS · 24 mm · handheld, off the Infinity's flank
action: The Infinity ripple-fires 150 missiles at Skerry in fifteen seconds: pod doors open in waves down the hull, plumes curve into a stream and race away. Skerry is fixed and its laser is the one thing that can burn the fleet's fins on the way in, so it goes first.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Infinity, Actual. Wave one, Skerry. Take their laser off the board. | INFINITY: Wave one away.
sound: Staccato launch cracks through the hull.

title: Turn and burn
camera: WS · 28 mm · 90° orbit round the Endeavor
action: The Endeavor pitches onto the approach line on RCS and its five engines light. Bow first, guns forward, fins stowed. Across the sky the whole group lights up together: 1 g for 34 minutes.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: All ships, execute. One g.
sound: Drive roar through the hull, rising.

title: Skerry burns
camera: EWS · 1,200 mm · from the fleet, Skerry a small grey disc
action: Pinpricks of white on Skerry's limb: wave one arriving, nose-on to the battery. The light left Skerry a second ago. On the plot the battery goes out and two of three tracks die; the depot burns.
comms: ASTRID SENSORS: Splash on Skerry. Their laser's gone. Two tracks down.
sound: Nothing, then a low swell of score.

title: Fins edge-on
camera: MS · 40 mm · dead ahead, slightly high
action: Coasting at 20 km/s with Skerry's laser gone, the Endeavor points its nose at distant Maren and runs its four fins out. From Site 1 and Breakwater, dead ahead, every fin is edge-on. They glow a dull red.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Fins out. Keep the nose on Maren; keep them edge-on.
sound: Hydraulic groan through the hull, then quiet.

title: The Breakers
camera: WS · 24 mm · tracking alongside
action: The fins retract before the debris. A faint haze thickens; a single large rock slides past, twenty kilometres off, gone across the frame in two seconds at 20 km/s. Drones and corvettes spread ahead.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Entering the Breakers. Fins in. Corvettes, sweep the lane.
vfx: Dust haze, glitter, one rock fly-by
sound: Low drone; dust ticking on the hull.

title: Blind
camera: CU · 85 mm · sensor mast, with POV insert
action: Site 1 finds the Endeavor through the haze. The mast's optics flare and the POV feed whites out; armoured shutters slam over the windows.
comms: ENDEAVOR SENSORS: Site One is painting us. Shutters on the mast.
vfx: Dazzle bloom on optics, POV whiteout
sound: A static howl on the feed, cut by the shutter slam.

title: The belt wakes
camera: WS · 40 mm · drifting past a rock
action: On a rock ahead, regolith heaves and petal doors open. Missiles tumble out unlit and fire their motors two kilometres clear. Until now the pods were the same temperature as the rock.
comms: ROCINANTE: Launch, launch! Cold birds off the rocks, bearing two-one-zero.
sound: Nothing, then a hiss.

title: Countermeasures
camera: MS · 35 mm · along the port flank
action: Chaff and flares bloom and a smoke screen unfurls, thinning as it spreads. CIWS barrels spin up and lay kill clouds ahead of the incoming missiles; the laser arrays track, lenses glowing violet, beams invisible. Missiles pop one by one.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Chaff and smoke. PD, weapons free.
vfx: Tracers, kill clouds, chaff, smoke, intercept flashes
sound: PDC brrrt through the hull; flare pops.

title: Railguns in the rocks
camera: WS · 50 mm · over the platform's shoulder
action: A buried platform unmasks 600 km off the Canterbury's bow and fires a ten-slug pattern straight down its path. With 20 km/s of closing speed the slugs arrive in thirteen seconds; the destroyer can only side-step on RCS.
comms: EXTENUATING CIRCUMSTANCES: Canterbury, jink! Slugs on your bow!
sound: Sharp cracks through the rock (camera on the platform).

title: Canterbury
camera: MS · 40 mm · beside the destroyer
action: The Canterbury is holed stern to bow. It vents air, its reactor scrams in a flash, and the hull parts in two, tumbling. Its drones drift, suddenly unled.
comms: EXTENUATING CIRCUMSTANCES: Canterbury's gone. | TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Extenuating, you have the net.
vfx: Entry flash, venting, hull break, debris
sound: A muffled impact; the comm channel dies to hiss.

title: Answer
camera: EWS · 135 mm · the Astrid in profile
action: The Astrid is coasting, so nothing has to stop: it swings its whole kilometre-long hull to bear, steadies on RCS, and fires down the spinal cannon, a blue-white bloom at the muzzle. Cut: 100 seconds later and 8,000 km away, the platform's rock erupts. The platform could not move.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Astrid, turn to bear. Spinal on the platform. | ASTRID GUNNERY: On. Firing. | TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Remember the Cant.
vfx: Spinal muzzle bloom; impact eruption on the rock
sound: A deep punch through the hull, then silence, then a delayed boom on the cut.

title: Screens out
camera: WS · 28 mm · behind the corvettes
action: Ahead, dozens of cold hides on the rocks crack open and drones pour out. Rocinante, Tantive IV, Wallfish and Normandy fan out to meet them, PD drones ahead of them.
comms: TANTIVE IV: Drones waking on the rocks ahead. Dozens.
assets: CV DRN-C DRN-L FX-DRN BRK SUB
sound: A rising whine in the score.

title: Return to sender
camera: HUD insert · Extenuating Circumstances
action: On the destroyer's plot, a block of drone tracks flips from red to teal: the ones still on a control link are hijacked and turned on their own swarm. The autonomous ones keep coming.
comms: EXTENUATING CIRCUMSTANCES: Got their links. Return to sender.
sound: Clipped data chatter.

title: Normandy
camera: MS · 40 mm · from the Wallfish
action: One autonomous drone slips the screen and dives on the Normandy. A plasma bomb goes off against its flank; the corvette breaks up in a spray of light.
comms: WALLFISH: One's through, on Normandy— | TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Normandy's gone. Close the gap.
assets: CV CV-BRK DRN-C FX-DRN FX-BREAK SUB
sound: A scream of metal through the Wallfish's hull, then nothing.

title: Turnover
camera: WS · 28 mm · 90° orbit, the smoke screen behind
action: Under smoke and an EW peak, one ship at a time, the fleet flips. The Endeavor's stern (drive, reactor, radiators) swings to face Maren and the drive lights: 1 g of braking for 34 minutes, into the lee of the Lee.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Turnover. One at a time. Brake for the Lee.
sound: Drive roar building through the hull.

title: Into the lee
camera: WS · 24 mm · low over the rock's surface
action: The Endeavor slides in over boulder fields and settles a few kilometres off the Lee, an 18 km rubble pile. From here the rock stands between the ship and Site 1, and Breakwater, directly beneath it. The rest of the fleet strings out along the rock's shadow line, 50 km apart.
comms: ENDEAVOR: In the lee. The rock's between us and Site One.
sound: Low creaks; RCS thumps.

title: Too hot
camera: MS · 35 mm · along the stern shoulders
action: Heat alarms. The slot doors slide open and all four fins telescope out, glowing orange as they dump the heat of the Breakers fight. For the first time in two hours the ship is bright.
comms: ENDEAVOR ENGINEERING: Sink ninety-four percent. Dumping heat.
vfx: Fin glow ramps, light spill on the hull
sound: Alarm tones; the fins' hydraulic groan.

title: Fin hit
camera: CU · 50 mm · on the port fin
action: A platform on another rock 800 km away has line of sight to the fins sticking out of the Lee's shadow. Ten slugs, 32 seconds of flight; the fins are halfway in when one clips the port fin. It shatters into glowing shards and coolant flashes to vapour.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Launch, eight hundred k! Fins in— | ENDEAVOR: Port fin's gone. Cut it loose.
sound: Metal shear through the hull; hiss.

title: Broadside
camera: WS → CU · 24 → 50 mm · push onto the port batteries
action: Fins stowed, the Endeavor rolls to bring its port turrets to bear; the well batteries rise on their lifts; the M-1Cs wake, arm and fire in sequence at the platform (fixed, so it cannot dodge). Thirty-two seconds later the platform's rock flashes.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Roll to port. Batteries up. Fire.
vfx: M-1C muzzle blasts (tracer style), slug streaks
rig: radiator_deploy →0.12; rail_traverse; rail_elevation; battery_raise 0→1; rail_wake; rail_lock; rail_arm; shot_a / shot_b; rail_scales; rail_heat
sound: Hammering cracks through the hull, each with its recoil clunk.

title: The frigate
camera: WS · 40 mm · over the Donnager
action: A Compact frigate that has sat cold behind a rock 60 km away swings out and fires its coilgun; the slug spalls the Endeavor's port belt. The Donnager's four batteries answer.
comms: DONNAGER: Frigate off the rock, sixty kilometres. Engaging.
vfx: Coilgun flash, spall on the Endeavor's belt, Donnager muzzle flashes
assets: CF GI GI-GUN EN-DMG LEE SUB
sound: Hammering cracks through the Donnager's hull.

title: Lance
camera: CU · 28 mm · the Endeavor's nose
action: The lance channels on the nose glow. At 40 km, inside the one range where a lance works, the Endeavor fires: a violet-white plasma ring crosses the gap in a blink and the frigate's midsection opens. Escape pods scatter as it breaks.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Lance, forty kilometres. Now.
vfx: Lance core glow, plasma bolt, frigate break-up
sound: A rising electric whine, then a crack.

title: The line
camera: HUD insert · Astrid plot
action: The plot shows the Lee, Breakwater and Site 1 in one straight line. Missiles fired down it will meet Site 1 and Breakwater nose-first; the other three sites cannot see Breakwater's sky. Readout: Endeavor sink 31 %, fins 3 of 4.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: That's the line: the Lee, Breakwater, Site One. Wave two on my mark. | EXCELSIOR: Park reports six drones on the shields. Engaging.
sound: Sensor tones; the score gathers.

title: Wave two
camera: WS · 24 mm · from the Lee's surface, looking along the line
action: The Pillar of Autumn and the Galactica ripple-fire from the lee: decoys, EW missiles and enough real warheads that Breakwater must answer. This wave is meant to be spent. Behind them the Infinity, empty, turns for the Nauvoo.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Mark. | PILLAR OF AUTUMN: Wave two away. | INFINITY: Infinity's dry. Heading home.
vfx: Two ripple launches, hundreds of plumes
assets: GI GI-MAV MSL-V FX-SWARM LEE SUB
sound: Staccato cracks; then the score drops out.

title: The net
camera: WS · 50 mm · over the Extenuating Circumstances
action: Hours after the moon spoke, Skerry's rounds arrive. Ahead of the fleet the destroyer's drones light up a spreading cloud of pellets, glittering in their lamps, lying across the lane. The fleet side-steps, drives angled off the line.
comms: EXTENUATING CIRCUMSTANCES: Skerry's rounds, right where we said. Canister, bursting ahead. | TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: All ships, come left two degrees.
vfx: Canister cloud glitter in drone lamps
sound: Dust ticking; data chatter.

title: The anvil
camera: EWS · 50 mm · over Maren's limb
action: Breakwater swings its turrets over the limb of Maren, tracking but silent: the fleet stays far outside the range its guns can hit. Its missile cells open instead. Along its orbit the ring's PD stations unmask.
comms: ASTRID SENSORS: Ring's unmasking along the orbit. Breakwater's cells are open.
vfx: Turret motion, cell doors, ring lights
sound: A low brass sting.

title: Blind it
camera: MS · 35 mm · the Endeavor's laser arrays
action: The Extenuating Circumstances floods the ring's links; the emplacements drop to their pre-loaded plans. Every laser array in the fleet turns on Breakwater's optics, lenses violet, beams invisible.
comms: EXTENUATING CIRCUMSTANCES: Their net's down. The ring's on local control. | ENDEAVOR: All arrays, dazzle Breakwater.
vfx: Lens glow, EW overlay on inserts
sound: Clipped data chatter; lens capacitors whine.

title: Wall of fire
camera: WS · 40 mm · above Breakwater
action: Wave three (the Casaba killers, launched from the approach) arrives in the same second, down the line, nose-on. Breakwater's PD wall fills the sky with tracers and dying decoys, but its lasers see only hardened noses.
comms: GALACTICA: Wave three, on target in three, two—
sound: Dense crackle in the score (no air, no bangs).

title: Casaba
camera: WS · 35 mm · off Breakwater's quarter
action: Three kilometres out, the surviving Casaba charges fire: nuclear plasma spears lance into Breakwater's drive section. Its engines and main thrusters go dark; the monitor is still whole, but it can no longer move.
comms: ASTRID SENSORS: Spears in. Breakwater's drive is dark.
vfx: Casaba jets, drive section breach, venting
sound: White noise, then silence.

title: Spinal
camera: EWS · 200 mm · the Astrid end-on, then Breakwater
action: The Astrid, still coasting bow-on at 14,700 km, steadies its whole hull on the crippled monitor and fires. Cut: three minutes later the slug enters through the Casaba breach amidships. Breakwater's back breaks in a chain of secondary flashes.
comms: TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: It can't move. Astrid, spinal. | ASTRID GUNNERY: Firing. Impact in three minutes.
vfx: Spinal muzzle bloom; impact, spall cone, break-up
assets: AST BW BW-BRK FX-SPINAL FX-BREAK SUB
sound: Everything drops out; then one deep boom on the cut to the impact.

title: Terms
camera: MS · 50 mm · slow drift through Breakwater's debris toward the Endeavor
action: Debris drifts past the Endeavor: three fins stowed, one stump, scars on the port belt. The CIWS barrels spin down and the lens glow fades.
comms: EXTENUATING CIRCUMSTANCES: Actual, MDC is on the line. They're asking for terms. | TIDEBREAK ACTUAL: Tell them Site One goes dark first.
sound: Ticking metal; a long exhale in the score.

title: Hold
camera: EWS · 35 mm · locked off
action: Site 1 is dark. Against Maren's night side, city lights below, the Endeavor runs out its three remaining fins, glowing orange, and dumps the heat of the day. Cut to black.
comms: ENDEAVOR: Site One's dark. Fins out.
sound: The score resolves; then silence.
